title: Navimower 0.4.3-beta25

Focused read-only diagnostics build for recovering Navimow active-error actions.

### Active error diagnostics
- Wider bundle-prefix scanning is used for the strongest public H5 candidates.
- Diagnostics capture bounded neighborhoods around **Clear and resume**, **Reboot Mower**, **Got it**, plus the current error code/title.
- The exported evidence now includes nearby string literals, command-like object fields, endpoint/method candidates, JavaScript references and broader native bridge/invoke calls.

### Safety
- Discovery remains public unauthenticated **GET-only**.
- It does not execute mower mutations, Clear/Resume/Reboot commands, notification-detail calls or notification read mutations.
- No new error-recovery action is exposed to Home Assistant in this beta; this build is only for evidence collection while a real mower is in an active error state.
